WITH RECURSIVE n(x) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT x+1 FROM n WHERE x<200)  INSERT INTO topics (id,kind,name,status,createdAt,plannedStartAt,plannedEndAt,repeatRule,eventId,cardId,error,revision,quietOverride,retainedItemIds,starred,quietNotifiedAfter,endingNotifiedAt) SELECT x,'Conversation',NULL,'Done',1700000000000+(x-1)*250*60000,NULL,NULL,NULL,x,NULL,NULL,0,0,'[]',0,NULL,NULL FROM n

WITH RECURSIVE n(x) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT x+1 FROM n WHERE x<200)  INSERT INTO topic_spans (id,topicId,startAt,endAt) SELECT x,x,1700000000000+((x-1)*250+30)*60000,1700000000000+((x-1)*250+50)*60000 FROM n

WITH RECURSIVE n(x) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT x+1 FROM n WHERE x<2000)  INSERT INTO import_records (id,pendingId,fileName,kind,startAt,endAt,byChannel,status,error,cardId,ingestComplete,revision,summaryRequested,speakersReady) SELECT x,'synthetic-'||x,'import-'||x,'Audio',1700000000000+x*60000,1700000000000+x*60000+30000,0,CASE WHEN x%100=0 THEN 'Transcribing' ELSE 'Done' END,NULL,NULL,1,0,CASE WHEN x%100=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,1 FROM n

WITH RECURSIVE n(x) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT x+1 FROM n WHERE x<50000)  INSERT INTO segments (id,startAt,endAt,sourceId,path,sizeBytes,status,attempts,nextRetryAt,error,completedAt,logId,sentMillis,voiceprintProcessedAt,playbackMillis,firstFailedAt,asrSource,redoPending,separateSpeakers,importRecordId,importChannel,speakerCount) SELECT x,1700000000000+x*60000,1700000000000+x*60000+30000,CASE WHEN x<=2000 THEN 'import' ELSE 'mic' END,'synthetic-'||x,100,CASE WHEN (x-1)%1000<10 THEN 'Pending' WHEN (x-1)%1000<15 THEN 'Failed' WHEN (x-1)%1000<18 THEN 'Running' WHEN (x-1)%1000<20 THEN 'Empty' ELSE 'Done' END,1,1700000000000,NULL,CASE WHEN (x-1)%1000>=20 THEN 1700000000000+x*60000+30000 END,NULL,0,CASE WHEN (x-1)%1000>=30 THEN 1700000000000+x*60000 END,0,NULL,NULL,0,1,CASE WHEN x<=2000 THEN x END,NULL,NULL FROM n

WITH RECURSIVE n(x) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT x+1 FROM n WHERE x<500000)  INSERT INTO transcript_lines (id,segmentId,startAt,endAt,text,speakerTag,speakerName,eventId,digestedAt,speakerScore,speakerPersonId,speakerManual,voiceInputJson,voiceInputPendingUntil,originalText) SELECT x,(21+((x-1)%49000)/980*1000+(x-1)%980),1700000000000+(21+((x-1)%49000)/980*1000+(x-1)%980)*60000+(x-1)/49000*1000,1700000000000+(21+((x-1)%49000)/980*1000+(x-1)%980)*60000+(x-1)/49000*1000+500,'合成原话：用于索引测量，非用户记录','speaker0',NULL,CASE WHEN (21+((x-1)%49000)/980*1000+(x-1)%980)%250>=30 AND (21+((x-1)%49000)/980*1000+(x-1)%980)%250<50 AND (21+((x-1)%49000)/980*1000+(x-1)%980)<=50000 THEN (21+((x-1)%49000)/980*1000+(x-1)%980)/250+1 END,1710000000000,NULL,NULL,0,CASE WHEN x%1000=0 THEN '{}' END,NULL,NULL FROM n
